name: Speak with our Quartermaster
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, the Frostwolf Quartermaster is looking for recruits, for tasks that lead into the mines of Alterac Valley.  Speak with him; he will tell you more.

Follow the road west into the bunker, then take the west exit and you'll find our quartermaster.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hail, adventurer! It is good to see a Champion like yourself, eager to do his part for the Horde. Speak with me again, for I have vital tasks for you...
